label: FS AP-T566D Wi-Fi 6 outdoor access point
description: FS AP-T566D - Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) outdoor access point: dual radio 2x2 MU-MIMO up to 1.8 Gbps, 256 clients (64 concurrent), 32 SSIDs, 1x 10/100/1000/2.5GBase-T Ethernet, 802.3af/at PoE, IP67, wall or pole mount, 260 x 140 x 71 mm.
notes:
Ports and power come from the **comparison table on the FS product pages**, which is the only place these APs publish a port census at all: the product page itself renders marketing copy for a keyless fetch, and the datasheet URLs 404. The table's **column order follows the page you are on** - the page's own product is column 1 and the rest keep catalogue order (N716, N516, N506, N506H, T566D) - which is worth knowing before reading a row across. **One port, and it is 2.5G:** '1x 10/100/1000/2.5GBase-T Ethernet Port'. Outdoor unit - IP67, 260 x 140 x 71 mm, wall/pole mount - so the single cable carries data and 802.3af/at power and there is no second socket to cable. 1.8 Gbps aggregate from a dual 2x2 radio, 256 max clients, 64 concurrent, 32 SSIDs.

The AP power inlet carries no wattage: the vendor publishes the PoE **class** and a DC input rating ('DC 12V/2A' is the adapter's rating, not a draw), so no `poeIn` figure is invented. `poeIn: 0` on the other sockets keeps the engine from treating a downlink port as a power inlet.
